SELECT grouped.package_name, latest.app_name, grouped.version_count, latest.release_id AS latest_release_id FROM ( SELECT package_name, COUNT(*) AS version_count FROM sys_apk_release
AND package_name = #{packageName}
GROUP BY package_name ) grouped INNER JOIN sys_apk_release latest ON latest.release_id = ( SELECT candidate.release_id FROM sys_apk_release candidate WHERE candidate.package_name = grouped.package_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN candidate.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, candidate.version_code DESC, candidate.release_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_apk_release named WHERE named.package_name = grouped.package_name AND named.app_name = #{appName} )
ORDER BY latest.version_code DESC, grouped.package_name ASC
